orientation.top_of_map: north; the pool is at the west (left), the wood edge at the east (right)
orientation.sun: LGT-pool-bank-01 sun from the west-south-west (from the pool side, lower left of the map); shadows fall toward the upper right
orientation.note_en: camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks; xy_m = xy x map_extent_m (origin top-left).

views.desc_en: low wide shot from the water surface toward the reed-fringed shore and the trampled mud where the dripping party scrambles out
eye-level medium shot from the fallen willow trunk across the flattened grass to the rough race circle marked with sticks
eye-level medium shot from inside the race circle back to the fallen willow trunk where the Mouse lectures, reeds and still water behind
high oblique wide shot from the wood edge over the grassy flat, the race circle and the reed beds out to the still pool with no far shore
eye-level close shot across the scuffed grass to a marker stick on the edge of the race circle, daisies and buttercups around it
low close shot from the wet mud out over the shallows to the round white water-lily pads floating on the still pool
eye-level medium shot through the tall northern reeds along the shore to the trampled mud where the dripping party gathers
high oblique wide shot from above the northern reed bed down across the shore to the whole race circle and the wood edge beyond
eye-level detail shot from the willow trunk into the southern reeds: curving stems, purple loosestrife and cream meadowsweet

calibration.method: landmark xy re-measured on the delivered layout_top.png (door/opening landmarks read at the gap in the wall line)
